frontmatter.name: db-architect
frontmatter.description: Reviews or designs ReefCare PostgreSQL schema, Goose migrations, sqlc queries and indexes. Use when adding/changing tables, constraints, migrations or important queries, and for docs/database-design.md.

frontmatter.name: go-reviewer
frontmatter.description: Reviews ReefCare Go backend changes for correctness, authorization, transactions, SQL efficiency and adherence to the modular-monolith dependency rules. Use after implementing or modifying a backend feature slice, before reporting it done.

frontmatter.name: reef-domain-expert
frontmatter.description: Reviews ReefCare reef-keeping domain correctness - water chemistry units and conversions, plausible parameter ranges, dosing and water-change calculations, livestock rules, knowledge-base content and assessment rules for safety and unsupported claims. Use when writing domain calculations, seed knowledge, or intelligence rules.

frontmatter.name: security-auditor
frontmatter.description: Audits ReefCare changes for security issues - authentication, sessions, authorization/IDOR, uploads, CSRF/CORS, secrets, logging of sensitive data, and LLM safety boundaries. Use before completing auth, sharing, upload, community or intelligence features, and in Phase 5.

frontmatter.name: assessment-rule

frontmatter.name: verify
frontmatter.description: Run ReefCare's verification checks (format, vet, lint, unit and integration tests, sqlc drift, migrations, frontend checks, build) and report actual results honestly. Use before declaring any task done.
